strings.site.tagline: Record and stream like a studio — scenes, sources, multistream, one clean app.
strings.site.description: A live-streaming and recording studio for Windows, macOS and Linux: scenes on the GPU, multi-track recording, multistream straight from your machine. No accounts, no telemetry, no AI. Free today; future versions may be sold.
